This process primarily results in the differentiation of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, as both subsets are present during this phase. The evidence confirms that T cells interact with MHC molecules, which is crucial for their survival and further differentiation. Therefore, the best description of the T cells during this phase is that they are CD4+ and CD8+ T cells.
